metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 2025 · Pluribus
metas.description: In a world overtaken by a mysterious wave of forced happiness, Carol Sturka, one of the immune few, must uncover what's really going on - and save humanity from its artificial bliss.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2026 · Widow's Bay
metas.description: A skeptical mayor leads the superstitious residents of a cursed New England island.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2025 · The Studio
metas.description: Follows a legacy Hollywood movie studio striving to survive in a world where it is increasingly difficult for art and business to live together.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2025 · Your Friends & Neighbors
metas.description: A hedge fund manager resorts to burglary after losing his job, targeting wealthy neighbors to maintain his family's lifestyle, but makes a fateful error breaking into the wrong home.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2025 · Murderbot
metas.description: A security android struggles with emotions and free will while balancing dangerous missions and desire for isolation, evading detection of its self-hacking as it finds its place.

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 2026 · Cape Fear
metas.description: A happily married couple faces a growing threat when a notorious killer from their past, Max Cady, is released from prison and seeks revenge.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2026 · Margo's Got Money Troubles
metas.description: A young mother struggles to make ends meet. When her estranged father offers help, she starts an OnlyFans account using his advice from pro wrestling. Though successful, she wonders if Internet fame comes at too high a cost.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2025 · Chief of War
metas.description: The story of the unification of the Hawaiian Islands from an indigenous perspective; a Hawaiian war chief joins a campaign to unite the warring islands in order to save them from the threat of colonization.

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 2026 · Lucky
metas.description: A reformed criminal is forced to confront her past and return to illicit activities for one final job, hoping to secure her freedom and leave her former life behind for good.

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 2025 · The Last Frontier
metas.description: Follows Frank Remnick, a U.S. Marshal in charge of the quiet and weathered barrens of Alaska, as he needs to deal with a prison transport plane crash full of violent inmates inside his jurisdiction.

metas.name: ★ 6.6 · 2025 · Smoke
metas.description: A troubled detective and an enigmatic arson investigator follow in the footsteps of two serial arsonists.

metas.name: ★ 6.3 · 2025 · Prime Target
metas.description: A post-graduate mathematics student discovers an effort being made to destroy his work in finding a pattern in prime numbers that would allow him to access every computer in the world.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2025 · Dope Thief
metas.description: Follows long-time friends and delinquents who pose as DEA agents to rob a house in the countryside, but end up unintentionally revealing and unraveling the biggest hidden narcotics corridor on the Eastern seaboard.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2026 · Maximum Pleasure Guaranteed
metas.description: A divorced mom gets caught up in a perilous web of blackmail, murder, and youth soccer.

metas.name: ★ 6.4 · 2026 · Imperfect Women
metas.description: Follows an investigation that dives deep into the murder of a wealthy woman and all the dark secrets uncovered about her life.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2026 · Star City
metas.description: Soviet cosmonauts, engineers, and intelligence officers risk everything in an ambitious space program aiming to be the first to reach the moon.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2026 · Last Seen
metas.description: Police dispatcher Ian Ridley's daughter Maggie disappeared years ago. He receives a call, believing it's her, and embarks on a relentless quest to find her and reunite his family, disregarding consequences.

metas.name: ★ 6.2 · 2026 · Brothers
metas.description: McConaughey and Harrelson they try to live together on a Texas ranch. That close space puts their friendship to the test.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2025 · Carême
metas.description: Born into the tumult of the French Revolution, Antoine Carême would rise from poverty to become one of history's most acclaimed chefs, crossing paths with such figures as Napoleon, Tsar Alexander, and the Rothschilds.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2025 · Long Way Home
metas.description: They'll ride refurbished vintage bikes from McGregor's Scottish home to Boorman's in England, taking a circuitous route through Northern Europe and the continent before reaching their destination.

metas.name: ★ 6.3 · 2025 · Government Cheese
metas.description: Hampton Chambers a newly released ex-convict striving to leave his criminal history behind and reunite with his family. Amidst this struggle, he grapples with frequent inexplicable moments of divine intervention.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2025 · Krank: Berlin
metas.description: After her private life falls apart, a young doctor seeking a fresh start takes over the emergency room in Berlin's toughest, most chaotic hospital. Battling staff resistance and a run-down system, she must unite her maverick team to save lives.

metas.name: ★ 5.9 · 2026 · Unconditional
metas.description: A mother-daughter vacation abroad takes a devastating turn when Gali is arrested for drug possession. Refusing to accept the charges, her mother Orna risks everything on a quest for freedom—only to get entangled in a web of Gali's secrets.
